description: Put a generated item behind a public link, so it can be posted, embedded in a page or opened by someone with no YouSpot account. Anyone holding the link can see it. revoke true takes an existing link away again. Returns the URL.

artifact_id.description: An artifact_id from a generator or list_artifacts.

revoke.description: Take an existing link away instead of making one.
